{{Quote|You got such a big bounty on that pretty head of yours! It be a shame not to collect!|The gang's leader|<ref name="Rebel Escape">{{JournalCite|7|Rebel Escape}}</ref>}}
This '''gang''' of hoodlums were after [[Mari (Courier)|Mari]] - a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] with a mark on her head. Determined to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], they caught her and encircled her. However, they were interrupted by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] intent on helping her. The gang members and spacers agreed to brawl it out, but, when the gang leader saw that the spacers had defeated his minions, he pulled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on them, only to be attacked out of the blue by [[Zardra]], who disposed of him with her [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]].
